metadata.question: Does the snow cover in southern Siberia increase between October 14, 2018 and October 29, 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Southern Siberia (roughly 50-55°N, 85-110°E) - Dates: October 14, 2018 and October 29, 2018 - Collection: MODIS Snow Cover products (MOD10A1/MYD10A1) or Sentinel-2 with NDSI - MODIS Terra Daily Snow Cover (MOD10A1.061) is ideal for snow cover analysis 2. Masking strategy: - For MODIS snow products, use the NDSI_Snow_Cover band - Snow is typically defined as NDSI_Snow_Cover >= 10 (values 0-100 represent % snow cover) - Need to mask clouds and invalid data - Calculate total snow-covered area for each date 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero (B): Snow area calculations succeed but show decrease/no increase - A: Snow area increases between the two dates - C1: No images found for one or both dates - C2: After masking, no valid pixels remain - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN/invalid values ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define southern Siberia region const southernSiberia = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([85, 50, 110, 55]); // 2. Define dates const date1 = '2018-10-14'; const date2 = '2018-10-29'; // 3. Load MODIS Snow Cover data const modisSnow = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD10A1'); // Get images for both dates const img1 = modisSnow.filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(southernSiberia) .mosaic(); const img2 = modisSnow.filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(southernSiberia) .mosaic(); // Check if collections have data const col1Size = modisSnow.filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(southernSiberia) .size() .getInfo(); const col2Size = modisSnow.filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(southernSiberia) .size() .getInfo(); console.log(`Oct 14 images: ${col1Size}, Oct 29 images: ${col2Size}`); if (col1Size === 0 || col2Size === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Process snow cover (NDSI_Snow_Cover band, values 0-100) const snowBand = 'NDSI_Snow_Cover'; // Create snow masks (snow >= 10% cover) const snow1 = img1.select(snowBand).gte(10); const snow2 = img2.select(snowBand).gte(10); // 5. Calculate snow-covered area const stats1 = snow1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: southernSiberia, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2 = snow2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: southernSiberia, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const snowPixels1 = stats1[snowBand + '_sum']; const totalPixels1 = stats1[snowBand + '_count']; const snowPixels2 = stats2[snowBand + '_sum']; const totalPixels2 = stats2[snowBand + '_count']; console.log(`Oct 14: Snow pixels=${snowPixels1}, Total=${totalPixels1}`); console.log(`Oct 29: Snow pixels=${snowPixels2}, Total=${totalPixels2}`); // 6. Validation if (totalPixels1 === 0 || totalPixels2 === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } if (snowPixels1 == null || snowPixels2 == null || isNaN(snowPixels1) || isNaN(snowPixels2)) { console.log('C3'); return; } // 7. Compare snow cover const snowArea1 = snowPixels1; const snowArea2 = snowPixels2; console.log(`Snow area change: ${snowArea1} -> ${snowArea2}`); console.log(`Difference: ${snowArea2 - snowArea1} pixels`); if (snowArea2 > snowArea1) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
